title: notodanthonia longifolia
intro: Notodanthonia longifolia, commonly known as the red button grass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, aiding in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Notodanthonia longifolia include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
